headline: US soldier arrested in UK over alleged Russian spying
standfirst: A rare joint operation between UK and US authorities has led to a high-stakes espionage

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: A US soldier was arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: London Metropolitan Police counterterror units worked with the FBI and the US military.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: It highlights deep intelligence cooperation between the US and UK against foreign threats.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for updates from the London Metropolitan Police and the US Department of Defense.

caption:
A US soldier has been arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia.

This arrest followed a coordinated effort between UK counterterror police, the FBI, and the US military. It is a significant development in international security cooperation. We are waiting for more details on the specific charges.
